name: FAKE5
description: FAKE5: a 5- or 10-voice poly in the style of the Sequential Take 5. Two oscillators with continuous shape, sub, noise, sync and FM 2>1, a Prophet-5-style 4-pole low-pass with drive, two DADSR envelopes with env routing, two LFOs, sixteen mod slots, vintage, overdrive, twelve effects and a plate reverb, arp and 64-step sequencer. The same engine as the FAKE5 VST3.
author: swtdr34mz
